TITLE: Invoice Settings - FastComments
HEADING: Invoice Settings
COMPANY_NAME_HELP: Shown in your dashboard, emails, and team invites. Not your billing name.
ERROR_COMPANY_NAME_REQUIRED: The company name can't be empty - other settings were saved.
INVOICE_EMAIL_HELP: This email will be used for invoices and billing notifications.
INVOICE_CURRENCY_HELP: This currency will be used for new subscriptions and invoices.
VAT_ID_HELP: Optional. Printed on your invoices. Select your billing country first, since it determines the ID type.
ERROR_VAT_ID_INVALID: That VAT / Tax ID isn't valid for the selected billing country, so it wasn't saved. Your other settings were saved.
ERROR_VAT_ID_COUNTRY_REQUIRED: Select your billing country before adding a VAT / Tax ID. Your other settings were saved.
ERROR_VAT_ID_COUNTRY_UNSUPPORTED: We can't record a VAT / Tax ID for the selected billing country. Your other settings were saved.
ERROR_VAT_ID_UPDATE_FAILED: We couldn't save your VAT / Tax ID with our payment provider. Please try again. Your other settings were saved.
ERROR_STRIPE_UPDATE_FAILED: Failed to update billing email in Stripe. Please try again or contact support.
ERROR_STRIPE_ADDRESS_UPDATE_FAILED: Failed to update billing address in Stripe. Please try again or contact support.
